```{r}
if (parset == 'local') {
  plan(multisession)
}

if (parset == 'gandalf') {
  plan(list(tweak(future.batchtools::batchtools_slurm,
                template = "batchtools.slurm.tmpl",
                resources = list(time = 60,
                                 ntasks.per.node = 12,
                                 mem = "70GB",
                                 job.name = 'black_box')),
          multicore))
}
```

Set up. I'm still trying to decide how much of this is general and how much bespoke.
